node: Healthcare, nursing, and workforce curriculum/testing suppliers
summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion found a compact US-listed universe around the node. The cleanest underfollowed direct exposures are American Public Education as a healthcare/nursing school operator and direct customer of curriculum/testing vendors, and HealthStream as a healthcare workforce learning, credentialing, compliance, and clinical-development platform. Adtalem is the obvious scaled healthcare-education reference name via Chamberlain and other healthcare programs. Pearson is included as a broader education content/testing reference supplier with nursing and healthcare courseware exposure, but its node purity is lower. This pass expands the public-company universe around healthcare, nursing, and allied-health curriculum/testing inputs. The clearest underfollowed supplier-style exposure is HealthStream, which sells healthcare workforce learning, clinical competency, credentialing, scheduling, and compliance software to healthcare organizations and students. CAE adds a physical simulation-equipment lane through healthcare simulation products used by hospitals, medical schools, and nursing schools. Stride is a second-order workforce-training provider through MedCerts, focused on allied-health certification programs. APEI is retained as a reference/customer anchor rather than a pure supplier because Rasmussen/Hondros expose the procurement path: nursing programs depend on LMS, curriculum/testing, AI tutoring/content tools, and licensure-aligned delivery vendors. D2L appears important to the APEI/Rasmussen evidence chain but is not included as a candidate because it is not a US-listed
